title.narrative: UUNICEF enhanced child protection across 17 Indian states, training 300,000 functionaries and supporting key policies. Collaborations with NALSA and the Supreme Court advanced inclusion and legal services for children with disabilities. Efforts improved justice access, reached 1.47 million through MHPSS, and expanded online safety and urban child protection initiatives.
